# Reproduction

Environment: Python 3.11, numpy 2.4.6, scipy 1.17.1, pandas 3.0.6, scikit-learn 1.9.1, torch 2.14.1 (CPU), joblib 1.6.0, pyarrow 26.0.0 (`requirements.txt`). BLAS single-threaded (set in the scripts). CPU only; each worker is one process with 1 CPU and < 6 GB.

## All at once
```
bash scripts/00_download.sh
python3 -I scripts/01_audit.py
bash scripts/run_all.sh 8       # 8 workers; SKIP="extra msrc ..." leaves stages out
```
`run_all.sh` runs the stages below in order (`main variants msrc 2pct extra inner50 kmstrong highR analyze`) with `xargs -P`; every stage writes its own raw directory, `analyze` writes the CSVs.

## Stages (what each runs, CPU time on the shared single-CPU workers we used)
| stage | command (per benchmark, split cell) | raw dir | CPU-h |
|---|---|---|---|
| `main` | `02_run.py BENCH {interp,lineage,extrap} --draws 10 --d 2` (n ∈ {10, 25, 50, 100, 200, 400}, n ≤ N/2; 7 designs, ~100 method variants) | `results/raw` | 3.3 |
| `variants` | the same for `extrap10`, `extrap50` (top 10 % / 50 % as targets) | `results/raw` | 1.4 |
| `2pct` | `--ngrid n2` with `n2 = round(0.02 N)`; n/N = 2 % secondary endpoint | `results/raw_2pct` | 0.9 |
| `msrc` | `--ngrid 100 --designs uniform,strat,pps,balanced --no-cat --msrc M --tag _M{10,30,100}` (interp, extrap) | `results/raw_msrc` | 0.4 |
| `extra` | `--ngrid 100` and `--ngrid n2`, `--designs uniform,strat,pps,balanced --no-cat --extra` (target-recalibrated estimators `recal-*` and weak-prior IRT `irtw-*`) | `results/raw_extra/{n100,2pct}` | not yet measured |
| `inner50` | extrap, n = 100, uniform/strat/pps/balanced, `--inner-frac 0.5 --tag _inner50` (larger-gap inner split for the tuning of λ) | `results/raw_inner50` | 0.1 |
| `kmstrong` | anchor design only, `BPRED_KMEANS=strong` (k-means n_init 10, 300 iterations instead of 1 / 25), n = 100, interp and extrap, 7 benchmarks | `results/raw_kmstrong` | 0.1 |
| `highR` | interp, extrap, n = 100, uniform/strat/pps/balanced, `--R 100 --tag _R100` (100 subset draws per fold; draws 0–9 equal the main run's) | `results/raw_highR` | about 1.5 CPU-hours in total (26 cells, 1 CPU each) |

The largest cells are `mmlu_pro`, `bbh`, `openllm_math` (up to ~25 min each in `main`). The Open LLM Leaderboard benchmarks dominate the cost.

Seeds: `BASE_SEED = 20261126` combined with the tuple (benchmark, split, fold, n, draw, design index); fold assignment uses seed 0; bootstraps use fixed seeds in the analysis scripts. Reruns on the same machine reproduce the pickles; other CPUs/BLAS were not tested.

| `TWO_PCT=1 python3 -I scripts/03_analyze.py results/raw_2pct results/twopct` | the same for n/N = 2 % |
